router_body:
name: plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: full job set selected
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: echo 'SELECTED plan-test linux gameplay macos macos-gameplay perf tier'
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
      - name: local gate wiring proof
        if: ${{ github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix') }}
        run: python3 -I ci/local-gate-test.py
      - name: local evidence gate
        if: ${{ !(github.event_name != 'pull_request' || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'full-matrix') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'ci') || contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'release-matrix')) }}
        run: echo 'Local gauntlet evidence is the gate; request ci or full-matrix for CI.'

ci.yml.plan-test:
# tier: pr
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'plan-test')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: the engine, at lair.pin
        run: tools/fetch-lair
      - run: python3 -I .lair/ci/tiers-test.py
      - run: python3 -I .lair/ci/memgate-test.py
ci.yml.linux:
# tier: pr
    name: linux x86-64 (fmt, tests, builds, goldens, pty rows in the container)
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'linux')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: the engine, at lair.pin
        run: tools/fetch-lair
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .wolf-bin
          key: lair-toolchain-linux-${{ hashFiles('.lair/wolf-toolchain.toml') }}
      - name: the pinned toolchain, by digest
        run: .lair/tools/fetch-toolchain
      # Exact recipe + runner architecture: no stale-image restore fallback.
      - name: restore the pinned Linux image
        id: container-cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        with:
          path: target/ci-container/image.tar
          key: lair-container-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('.lair/ci/Containerfile') }}
      - name: provision the pinned Linux image
        run: python3 -I tools/ci-container.py prepare
      # Save BEFORE tests: even a costly cold fill followed by a test timeout
      # leaves the next attempt a warm cache. A failed build is never saved.
      - name: save the pinned Linux image
        if: steps.container-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        uses: actions/cache/save@v4
        with:
          path: target/ci-container/image.tar
          key: ${{ steps.container-cache.outputs.cache-primary-key }}
      - name: the Linux leg, in the container
        run: python3 -I tools/ci-container.py run -- tools/check-linux --no-gameplay
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: linux-evidence
          path: |
            target/goldens
            target/pty
            target/test.log
ci.yml.gameplay:
# tier: pr
    # The gameplay gates, one backend a leg, beside the Linux leg (cb19,
    # R-cb19-7 B): with them the leg outran its sixty minutes. The timeout
    # is the house rule's, (the peak phases + 180 s) x 1.4 for the native
    # leg, the slower: 9 s set-up, 14 s image, 13 s build, 1,522 s gameplay,
    # 15 s upload (cub#93's run 41274530832) -> 2,454 s, 41 minutes.
    name: gameplay semantics, ${{ matrix.backend }} (in the container)
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'gameplay')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 41
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        backend: [native, release]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: the engine, at lair.pin
        run: tools/fetch-lair
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .wolf-bin
          key: lair-toolchain-linux-${{ hashFiles('.lair/wolf-toolchain.toml') }}
      - name: the pinned toolchain, by digest
        run: .lair/tools/fetch-toolchain
      - name: restore the pinned Linux image
        id: container-cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        with:
          path: target/ci-container/image.tar
          key: lair-container-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('.lair/ci/Containerfile') }}
      - name: provision the pinned Linux image
        run: python3 -I tools/ci-container.py prepare
      - name: save the pinned Linux image
        if: steps.container-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        uses: actions/cache/save@v4
        with:
          path: target/ci-container/image.tar
          key: ${{ steps.container-cache.outputs.cache-primary-key }}
      - name: the build and the gameplay gate, in the container
        run: python3 -I tools/ci-container.py run -- tools/check-gameplay ${{ matrix.backend }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: gameplay-evidence-${{ matrix.backend }}
          path: target/gameplay
ci.yml.macos:
name: macOS arm64 (build, goldens, pty rows)
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'macos')
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: the engine, at lair.pin
        run: tools/fetch-lair
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .wolf-bin
          key: lair-toolchain-macos-${{ hashFiles('.lair/wolf-toolchain.toml') }}
      - name: the pinned toolchain, by digest
        run: .lair/tools/fetch-toolchain
      - name: wolf fmt --check
        run: .lair/tools/check-fmt
      - name: the unit tests
        run: .lair/tools/test
      # RULES section 4's memory gate is nomad's (the maintainer's Mac); the
      # runner's free-memory figure means nothing for it (lair's lib-mem.sh).
      - name: build, both tiers
        env:
          LAIR_MEMORY_GATE: '0'
        run: .lair/tools/build --all
      - name: resident growth, crash checkpoint and fresh seed
        run: sh tools/check-memory target/release/cub
      - name: the goldens, both tiers
        env:
          LAIR_MEMORY_GATE: '0'
        run: .lair/tools/goldens
      - name: the native goldens
        env:
          LAIR_MEMORY_GATE: '0'
        run: .lair/tools/goldens --bin target/native/cub
      - name: the pty rows
        env:
          LAIR_MEMORY_GATE: '0'
        run: python3 -I .lair/tools/pty --bin target/release/cub
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: macos-evidence
          path: |
            target/goldens
            target/pty
ci.yml.macos-gameplay:
# The gameplay gates on both backends on a macOS runner, beside the macOS
    # leg (cb19, R-cb19-7 B, as the Linux leg's). The timeout is the house
    # rule's, (the peak phases, scaled by cub#93's growth over trunk's,
    # + 180 s) x 1.4: 8 s set-up, 61 s build, the gameplay step's peak
    # 1,440 s on trunk (run 41047553331) x 1.06 = 1,526 s, 17 s upload and
    # post -> 2,509 s, 42 minutes.
    name: macOS arm64 gameplay semantics (both backends)
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'macos-gameplay')
    runs-on: macos-latest
    timeout-minutes: 42
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: the engine, at lair.pin
        run: tools/fetch-lair
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .wolf-bin
          key: lair-toolchain-macos-${{ hashFiles('.lair/wolf-toolchain.toml') }}
      - name: the pinned toolchain, by digest
        run: .lair/tools/fetch-toolchain
      - name: build, both tiers
        env:
          LAIR_MEMORY_GATE: '0'
        run: .lair/tools/build --all
      - name: gameplay semantics, native
        env:
          LAIR_MEMORY_GATE: '0'
        run: python3 -I tools/gameplay.py --bin target/native/cub
      - name: gameplay semantics, release
        env:
          LAIR_MEMORY_GATE: '0'
        run: python3 -I tools/gameplay.py --bin target/release/cub
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: macos-gameplay-evidence
          path: target/gameplay
ci.yml.perf:
name: performance (render, idle, input latency)
    needs: plan
    if: contains(fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.jobs || '[]'), 'perf')
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: tools/fetch-lair
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: .wolf-bin
          key: lair-toolchain-linux-${{ hashFiles('.lair/wolf-toolchain.toml') }}
      - run: .lair/tools/fetch-toolchain
      - name: restore the pinned Linux image
        id: container-cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v4
        with:
          path: target/ci-container/image.tar
          key: lair-container-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-${{ hashFiles('.lair/ci/Containerfile') }}
      - name: provision the pinned Linux image
        run: python3 -I tools/ci-container.py prepare
      - name: save the pinned Linux image
        if: steps.container-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        uses: actions/cache/save@v4
        with:
          path: target/ci-container/image.tar
          key: ${{ steps.container-cache.outputs.cache-primary-key }}
      - name: release bench and live latency, in the container
        run: python3 -I tools/ci-container.py run -- tools/check-perf
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
        with:
          name: perf-evidence
          path: target/perf
ci.yml.tier:
name: tier ${{ needs.plan.outputs.tier || 'unplanned' }}
    if: ${{ !cancelled() }}
    needs:
      - plan
      - plan-test
      - linux
      - gameplay
      - macos
      - macos-gameplay
      - perf
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: the engine, at lair.pin
        run: tools/fetch-lair
      - env:
          NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: python3 .lair/ci/tiers.py verdict
ci.yml.nightly-red:
name: nightly red, an issue
    needs: tier
    if: ${{ failure() && github.event_name == 'schedule' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: the engine, at lair.pin
        run: tools/fetch-lair
      - env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          WORKFLOW: ${{ github.workflow }}
          RUN_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}
        run: .lair/ci/nightly-red.sh
